MOD = 998244353; G = 3

def ntt(a, invert):
    n = len(a); j = 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        bit = n >> 1
        while j & bit:
            j ^= bit; bit >>= 1
        j ^= bit
        if i < j: a[i], a[j] = a[j], a[i]
    length = 2
    while length <= n:
        w = pow(G, (MOD-1)//length, MOD)
        if invert: w = pow(w, MOD-2, MOD)
        for i in range(0, n, length):
            wn = 1
            for k in range(length//2):
                u = a[i+k]; v = a[i+k+length//2]*wn % MOD
                a[i+k] = (u+v) % MOD
                a[i+k+length//2] = (u-v) % MOD
                wn = wn*w % MOD
        length <<= 1
    if invert:
        inv_n = pow(n, MOD-2, MOD)
        for i in range(n): a[i] = a[i]*inv_n % MOD

def poly_mul_ntt(a={{a}}, b={{b}}):
    n = 1
    while n < len(a)+len(b): n *= 2
    A = a + [0]*(n-len(a)); B = b + [0]*(n-len(b))
    ntt(A, False); ntt(B, False)
    C = [(x*y) % MOD for x, y in zip(A, B)]
    ntt(C, True)
    return C[:len(a)+len(b)-1]
